flows.title: Saved library persistence and deletion through the real local API

assertions.expected: An upgraded saved translation keeps its cues and cost when reopened
Restart preserves playlists; confirmed deletion removes all memberships and preserves the other video
Adding and opening an untranslated entry creates no processing job

flows.title: Library and playlist actions in Chromium with the real local API

assertions.expected: Saved subtitles retain their times and cost without a translation request
Playlist names, order and memberships survive a process restart
Cancelling named permanent deletion preserves the saved translation
Confirmed deletion removes the video from every playlist and preserves unrelated data
Opening an untranslated playlist entry leaves translation unstarted
